hypothesis: The dense true-pitch-group expert oracle has a large control ceiling, while explicit pitch classifiers and probability marginalization compound errors. Distilling the oracle-minus-exact-C soft risk directly from a completed historical fold can learn its deployable conditional expectation without exposing the current validation pitch group.

relationship_to_prior_work.physics_teacher: Prior LUPI distilled current-pitch TrackMan physics or physics-adjusted command, not the dense pitch-expert oracle delta.
relationship_to_prior_work.control_relevant_selector: Prior direct regression targeted a leave-one-out pitcher-by-fine-pitch difficulty scalar, not an outer-OOF full contextual probability delta.
relationship_to_prior_work.dense_moe_and_joint: Prior deployable systems multiplied selector and expert probabilities or classified outcome-by-group. This student learns the soft oracle risk in one regression target.

data_contract.teacher_recipe: 2020 outer-OOF dense physics pitch experts trained only on 2019, routed by the reconstructed 2020 pitch group after 2020 became completed history

student.training_scope: 2020 regular-season rows with reconstructed teacher group
student.features: official row-local train/test common columns except row_id and season, plus exact-C probability and logit
student.selection: maximize 2021 R gain, then full gain, then smaller scale

source_gate.on_fail: Close without constructing a 2022 student candidate.
source_gate.on_pass: Freeze model, feature list and correction scale; train from accumulated completed-fold teachers for 2022/2023, then apply the V5 contract before opening a 2024 candidate.
